FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi

  SELECT ORDER_ID, SKU, SUBTOTAL / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ORDER_ID) AS SUBTOTAL_PER_ITEM

       100.0 * SUM(PAYMENT_VALUE) / SUM(SUM(PAYMENT_VALUE)) OVER () AS pct_of_total
FROM ORDER_PAYMENTS
GROUP BY PAYMENT_TYPE
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, PAYMENT_TYPE

SELECT PAYMENT_TYPE,
       SUM(PAYMENT_VALUE) AS total_amount_paid,
       100.0 * SUM(PAYMENT_VALUE) / SUM(SUM(PAYMENT_VALUE)) OVER () AS pct_of_total
FROM ORDER_PAYMENTS
GROUP BY PAYMENT_TYPE
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, PAYMENT_TYPE

WITH firsts AS (
  SELECT c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID AS person,
         date_trunc('month', MIN(o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP)) AS cohort_month
  FROM ORDERS o
  JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
  GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
),
person_volume AS (
  SELECT c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID AS person,
         SUM(oi.PRICE) AS bv
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi
  JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
)
SELECT f.cohort_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.person) AS cohort_customers,
       COALESCE(SUM(pv.bv), 0) AS cohort_lifetime_business_volume
FROM firsts f
LEFT JOIN person_volume pv ON pv.person = f.person
GROUP BY f.cohort_month
ORDER BY f.cohort_month
